verdict.rationale: Recurly has a REST API and official client libraries covering subscription plan changes and credit invoices (recurly-docs-1, recurly-docs-16, recurly-docs-9, recurly-docs-13), which is a programmatic surface an agent could call, but the only AI-agent-specific surface documented (Compass MCP) is explicitly for documentation/API knowledge lookup, not execution of billing actions (recurly-docs-12, recurly-docs-24, recurly-probe-2). Missing for 10: explicit subscription-creation API evidence, a scoped-permission/API-key model for agent access, and an actual agent-executable action layer (vs. docs-only MCP).
